🚨 President Trump just shared something every American needs to understand. 

Here it is in plain English.

An analyst looked at 59 Senate and governor races this year and compared them to Trump's 2024 numbers. 

What they found is wild.

In almost every state, Republicans got about 85% of Trump's 2024 vote. 

The other 15% showed up on the Democrat side.

Here's the strange part. 

It didn't matter if the state was deep red like Wyoming or deep blue like Massachusetts. 

The same 15% shift showed up almost everywhere. 

Different candidates, different campaigns, same number.

That 15% is exactly what flipped Texas, Kansas, Iowa, Ohio, South Carolina and North Carolina. 

Any state where Trump won with under about 58.5% fell below 50% once you take that 15% away.

Real elections are messy. 

Numbers this neat raise real questions.

The fix is simple: hand count the paper ballots, check the poll books against the votes counted, and release the voter files.

If there's nothing to hide, let's see the ballots. 🇺🇸
